capacityDispatchRule: conformance-capacity-coverage-v1.json selects exactly one generatorProfile whose executionClass and safeBaselineId match the axis record
expansionRule: Every generated Case stores all resolved literals; no executor or generator may consult capacity defaults, overrides, ambient environment, current time, or latest profile at runtime.
identityRule: Any parameter-schema, algorithm, output-contract, baseline, or vector semantic change requires a new exact generatorProfile.
implementationGate: A generator remains non-referenceable until its implementation bytes, implementation manifest, target manifest, and complete golden vectors are frozen.
